concepts.headline: Black Friday: was $180, yours for $99.95
concepts.prompt: Recreate the street + truck idea from the SECOND attached image: a real street photo of a white delivery box truck with a dusting of snow and a garland along the roof edge. Its side panel is printed like a giant holiday ad on deep red: HUGE white heavy caps "BLACK FRIDAY" filling the top half, under it bold white "40% OFF"; below, smaller: a printed photo of the white DentalPULSE Pod from the first reference image wrapped with a big white satin bow, a bright white denture beside it, and white text "The gift of clean dentures. Was $180, now $99.95". HOLIDAY GIFT THEME: festive but premium: wrapped gift boxes with satin ribbon bows, a little fresh pine and warm string-light bokeh; colors DentalPULSE navy, white, red and a touch of gold. HIERARCHY (critical): the Black Friday message is the BIGGEST, boldest element, readable in one second at thumbnail size; the product is secondary. REALISM: real photograph / real designed ad look, natural light and shadows, not an AI render. The ONLY words in the image are the quoted texts above, each rendered exactly once and spelled exactly; no other text, no logos except the DentalPULSE wordmark where quoted and the wordmark printed on the Pod, no competitor or brand names. POD RULES: the DentalPULSE Pod RESTS on a surface; NOBODY holds it. Compact device about 13 cm wide and 8.5 cm tall. Do NOT show any travel bag, pouch or dental case. Any appliance is about HALF the Pod's width. A stained denture is UNMISTAKABLY yellow-brown; a clean one has bright white teeth and fresh pink gums.
